=== effective paths and ports in both directions ===
Paths:
  rx   PATH                  inherited
  rw   config + temporary    /reference
  rw   temporary             /output
Host → sandbox: 3000 http://127.9.9.9:3000
Sandbox → host: 8080 127.0.0.1:8080
=== every permanent path kind ===
Caps: r read · x shell · w workspace/home · g git · n network/fetch · l lookup
Paths:
  rw   cache + sockets       /cache
  r    drops                 /drops
  rw   git                   /repo/**/.git
  rw   home                  /home
  r    modules               cache
  r    runtime               process + resolver
  rw   runtime               ptys
  r    skills                2 enabled
  r    system                read-only
  rw   system                devices
  rx   system                executables
  rxw  tmp + sockets         /tmp

  rx   PATH                  /path/{one,two}
  r    modules               /modules/cache

  rw   runtime               /runtime/ptys
  r    skills                /skills/{one,two}

=== read-only workspace ===
Caps: r read
Paths:
  r    workspace             /workspace
=== writable workspace and denied names ===
Caps: r read · w workspace/home
Paths:
  rw   workspace             /workspace
Limits: .git needs g under writable grants · deny .env, *.pem in tools + shell
=== yolo deny scope ===
Caps: r read · x shell · w workspace/home
Paths:
  rxw  workspace             /workspace
  rxw  yolo shell            /
Limits: .git in path tools needs g; yolo shell is unrestricted · deny .env in path tools only
